name: gala-reconciler-web
description: Client assets for GALA Reconciler: Tailwind CSS build and the SignalR browser client

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('wwwroot/lib/signalr', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/@microsoft/signalr/dist/browser/signalr.min.js', 'wwwroot/lib/signalr/signalr.min.js');"
